principals.name: A
principals.description: The initiator: requests a session key from S, decrypts S's response using Ksa, and forwards B's encrypted ticket.

principals.name: B
principals.description: The responder: receives A's ticket and decrypts it using Ksb to obtain and accept the session key.

principals.name: S
principals.description: The trusted authentication server: generates session keys and timestamps, and encrypts the response for A under Ksa and the ticket for B under Ksb.

values.name: Ksa
values.description: Ksa is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: Ksb
values.description: Ksb is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
